units.source_text: 舞女口口声声地喊着大叔大叔，请求这汉子给她朗读《水户黄门漫游记》。

en.t: The dancing girl kept calling out, "Uncle, Uncle," and begged the man to read Mito Komon Manyuki aloud to her.

units.source_text: 但是，这汉子读不多久，便站起来走了。

en.t: But before the man had read for long, he stood up and left.

units.source_text: 舞女不好意思直接对我说“接着给我朗读呀”，便一个劲儿请求阿妈，好像要阿妈求我读。

en.t: The dancing girl was too shy to say directly to me, "Please keep reading aloud," so she kept pleading with Mother, as if trying to get Mother to ask me to read.

units.source_text: 我怀着期待的心情，把说书本子拿起来。

en.t: With a feeling of anticipation, I picked up the storytelling booklet.

units.source_text: 舞女果然轻快地靠近我。

en.t: Sure enough, the dancing girl came lightly over to me.

units.source_text: 我一开始朗读，她就立即把脸凑过来，几乎碰到我的肩膀，表情十分认真，眼睛里闪出了光彩，全神贯注地凝望着我的额头，一眨也不眨。

en.t: As soon as I began reading aloud, she at once brought her face close, almost touching my shoulder; her expression was utterly serious, her eyes shone, and she stared intently at my forehead without blinking.

units.source_text: 好像这是她请人读书时的习惯动作。

en.t: It seemed this was her habitual gesture when she had someone read to her.

units.source_text: 刚才她同火锅店老板也几乎是脸碰脸。

en.t: A moment earlier, she had been almost face to face with the hot-pot shop owner too.
I had been watching her all along.

units.source_text: 她那双亮晶晶的又大又黑的眼珠娇媚地闪动着，这是她全身最美的地方。

en.t: Her bright, large, black eyes flickered with a charming allure, and they were the most beautiful part of her whole body.

units.source_text: 双眼皮的线条也优美得无以复加。

en.t: The lines of her double eyelids were also supremely graceful.
When she smiled, she was like a fresh flower.

units.source_text: 用笑起来像一朵鲜花这句话来形容她，是恰如其分的。

en.t: To describe her by saying that when she smiled she was like a fresh flower was exactly right.
